title: Korea Holds 1st AI Creative Contest for Children to Make Webtoons
content:
Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) held the finals of its 2026 AI Creative Contest on October 24 at Kakao AI Campus, inviting young children and elementary school students to create stories, songs, and webtoons using artificial intelligence.

The contest, held for the first time this year, was part of the ministry's National AI Competition and centered on the theme of "A Future Living Alongside AI."

Organizers provided four AI tools developed by South Korean companies: Solar, Math AI, Miricanvas, and Witoon. Preliminary rounds took place in 10 regions across the country, beginning in Busan on June 21, and drew approximately 1,700 participants.

Before creating their works, participants received instruction in AI ethics and how to use the tools. Mentors consisting of current elementary school teachers also helped children unfamiliar with the technology apply what they had learned.

The final round was organized as a family-oriented AI creative festival, drawing approximately 300 finalists and family members to Kakao AI Campus. Attendees also took part in various AI activities after the competition.
author: ANN

title: Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- Visual Novel's Video Previews Story, Systems, New Characters
content:
The official website for the Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- ( Rakuen Tsuihō -The Stellar Angel- ) game began streaming a promotional video for the visual novel on Thursday. The video reveals the game's original story, systems, and the new characters Naamah and Aradia.

Studio51 is developing the game. Shotaro Teshirogi, who wrote the Expelled from Paradise : mission.0 prequel novel for the original film, is writing the game's story. The game includes voice acting in all major scenes.

The game's website describes the game's story:

A.D. 2400. Ever since the Nano Hazard, a catastrophic event that laid waste to the surface world, 98% of humanity has abandoned both the ravaged Earth and their own flesh and blood to migrate to the virtual world of DEVA. Now, a strange new lifeform has suddenly begun sprouting on the surface: the Paraflora. As it spreads at alarming speed, colossal worms have started to appear nearby, attacking people one after another. At the heart of the outbreak lies Svarga, a desert town that was long ago abandoned due to a plague. Meanwhile, an agent of DEVA's Security Bureau has stolen Grey Goo, a top-secret file holding data on the Nano Hazard, and fled to the surface. Their trail, too, leads to Svarga. And now, in this ghost town shrouded in mystery and conspiracy, several competing agendas are about to converge.

The game's story uses a system dubbed as "K2-System," which divides choices players can make in the game's story into "Kizuna" (Bonds) and "Kakugo" (Resolve) choices. Kizuna choices emphasize the bonds that Angela makes in the surface world, while Kakugo choices emphasize Angela's resolve to see her mission through. Choices determine how the story branches into different routes, including bad ends.

The game will launch for the Switch and PC via Steam on November 26. The game is getting an English release . The game will have support in English and Japanese.

Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, will open in Japan on November 13.

While the original announcement of the film had featured the title Rakuen Tsuihō : Libera ted from Paradise , a later announcement listed the title as Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance as well as Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance instead.

The cast members are:

• Ayane Sakura as Gabriel

• Saori Hayami as Alma

• Yoshino Aoyama as Danel

• Sally Amaki as Raguel

• Sumire Morohoshi as Penem

Rie Kugimiya reprises her role as Angela Balzac in the film.

The film reunites the main staff of Expelled from Paradise , including director Seiji Mizushima , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , character designer Masatsugu Saitō , and composer NARASAKI . Toei Animation is producing the animation.

The other staff members include:

• Mechanical Designers: Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki, Takayuki Yanase

• Animation Supervisor: Naoki Ogita

• Modeling Supervisor: Kento Kume

• Mecha Modeling Lead: Toyokazu Hashimoto

• Producer: Kōichi Noguchi

Expelled from Paradise debuted in 13 theaters in Japan in November 2014, and sold 110,000 tickets. The film's Blu-ray Disc and DVD release in Japan sold more than 70,000 copies. The film won the Best Animation of the Year Award at the 24th Japan Movie Critics Awards in May 2015.

The film returned to theaters in Japan in November 2024 in 4K resolution as Expelled from Paradise -Impelled by 10th Anniversary- to commemorate the film's 10-year anniversary.

title: No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy! TV Anime Reveals 7 Cast, More Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yui Hata 's No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy! manga, the adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa 's Saijakuna Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe o Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Hōshū o Mugen Kaishū Dekimashita! novel series, revealed new cast and staff members on Thursday.

The newly announced cast members are (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

Nao Ojika as Auroia

Kengo Tsujii as Don

Tatsuhisa Suzuki as Guillermo

Anna Yamaki as Scarlet

Shun Horie as Latch

Ayasa Itō as Maris

Hinata Tadokoro as Volks

Previously announced character designers Hiroshi Miyamoto and Sumakidori are also the anime's chief animation directors. Sumakidori is also in charge of costume and prop design.

Additional new staff members are:

• 3DCG Director: Yui Horiuchi

• Color Design: Akemi Tejima

• Art Director: Norifumi Nakamura

• Editing: Takahiro Adachi

• Sound Production: Sonilude

• Sound Director: Yūichi Imaizumi

• Music: Kyōhei Matsuno

The anime will star Riko Aono as Henri and Momoka Terasawa as Elelet (character name romanizations are not confirmed).

Haruki Kasugamori ( Dragon Goes House-Hunting , Tono to Inu ) is directing the anime at Durandal and Tengu Kobou . Hiroshi Hosokawa ( Otherworldly Munchkin ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Saint Seiya: Legend of Sanctuary , Eiga Precure Dream Stars! ) and Sumakidori ( Miru: Paths To My Future ) are designing the characters.

Kodansha 's K MANGA service publishes the manga adaptation in English and describes the story:

All the rare items you could hope for...and all the dizzyingly high stats you could dream of! Henri, a boy who needs money to care for her ailing sister, has just been laid off his own party thanks to having nothing but the weak, valueless "Evade" skill to his name. Life seems hopeless for him...until he stumbles upon a way to use "Evade" to go right through the walls of monster-laden labyrinths! What better way is there for a level-1 weakling to earn as many first-clear rewards as he wants—without even bothering with the bosses guarding them?

Kitagawa debuted the web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in February 2021. The light novels launched in June 2022 with illustrations by Meto Sasame . The second volume shipped in May 2024.

Hata began a manga adaptation in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R in July 2022 until the magazine ended publication in January 2023. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app that same month. Kodansha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on July 9.

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals 6 New Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed six new cast members and the artists for the anime's theme songs on Friday. Yui Makino will perform the opening theme song "PROMISE ME," and the band Skoop on Somebody will perform the ending theme song "Akashi" (Proof).

The newly announced cast members are:

Tōru Furusawa as Hideo Tanimura, Tōzai Shimbun's deputy editor-in-chief and Culture Department manager

Kōsuke Echigoya as Tomio Tomii, Tōzai Shimbun's Culture Department deputy manager

Nobuo Tobita as Taizō Ōhara, the owner of Tōzai Shimbun

Hiroshi Naka as Kyōichi Koizumi, Tōzai Shimbun's director and editor-in-chief

Kyō Yaoya as Kinue Arakawa, reporter for Tōzai Shimbun's Culture Department

Hiroko Ushida as Noriko Mitani, another reporter for Tōzai Shimbun's Culture Department

The anime will star:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: The Remarried Empress Webtoon Launches Side Stories Ahead of Disney+ Live-Action Series
content:
Naver WEBTOON announced on October 28 that the The Remarried Empress webtoon will launch side stories on its Daily Plus service on October 29 at 10:00 p.m. KST. The new episodes will also be available on the platform's global services.

Note: The below two paragraphs contain spoilers for the end of the webtoon series.

Written by Alphatart and adapted into a webtoon by writer Heree and artist SUMPUL , The Remarried Empress follows Empress Navier, who responds to her emperor husband's demand for a divorce by seeking to remarry. The side stories will feature newlywed life for Navier and Heinrey after the birth of their twins, as well as stories about supporting characters that the main series did not fully explore.

The new episodes will also include alternate-universe stories that imagine different scenarios, such as revisiting the day Emperor Sovieshu announced his divorce or Rashta becoming Navier's maid.

The side stories debut ahead of the live-action adaptation. The Disney+ original series will premiere on November 4.

The webtoon has over 2.97 billion global views and has been translated into 10 languages. The series has a strong international following, particularly in Japan.

The webtoon ended in January after a seven-year run, but announced in February it would return this fall for side stories.

The English version of the The Remarried Empress webtoon is available on WEBTOON . Ize Press is releasing the series in print.

The webtoon also has an upcoming anime adaptation slated to debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: 'Shin Oishinbo' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo , revealed additional cast and theme songs on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Cast Hideo Tanimura: Tohru Furusawa ( Toradora! ) Tomio Tomii: Kousuke Echigoya ( Akane-banashi ) Taizou Oohara: Nobuo Tobita ( World Is Dancing ) Kyouichi Koizumi: Hiroshi Naka ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) Kinue Arakawa: Kyou Yaoya ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Noriko Mitani: Hiroko Ushida ( Liar Game )

Japanese singer Yui Makino ( Poputepipikku ) will perform the opening theme "PROMISE ME," while Skoop On Somebody ( Bleach ) will perform the ending theme "Akashi."

Kenichi Nishida ( Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei ) is directing the anime at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Tensei shitara Ken deshita ) is handling the series composition, while Nozomi Kawashige ( Deatte 5-byou de Battle ) is designing the characters.

Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki . Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010.

Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992.

title: Good Smile Company: Full Credit Card Details for 2,800 Customers May Have Been Exposed in Data Breach
content:
Good Smile Company released on Thursday a new update regarding the data breach on its online store where an "unauthorized third party" gained access to personal and other information if its members. The company stated that its investigation has established that a malicious program was present on the website's credit card payment page from October 21 at 1:55 p.m. JST to October 23 at 7:00 a.m. JST. The information concerning the installation of the malicious program was discovered on October 28 shortly after 6:30 p.m. JST. The company stated that the vulnerability believed to be the cause of the issue is different from the PHP vulnerability.

The company now states that 2,800 customers who may have entered their information on the website's credit card payment page during that time may be affected by the issue, and their information such as cardholder's name, complete 16-digit card number, expiration date, and security code may have been exposed. The company stated that it has contacted the affected customers by email separately.

Additionally, the company stated that customers who have previously registered their credit card information on the website may have their partial information exposed, including the last four digits of the card and expiration date. The company confirmed that cardholders' names or security codes have not been exposed, and no registered member information linked to the exposed partial information was exposed. The company estimated that the number of credit cards that may have partial information exposed is 402,466 excluding duplicates.

The company added that 7,673 customers who placed orders on October 22 between shortly before 10:20 p.m. JST and shortly before 11:00 p.m. JST may have their order information exposed. Information that may have been exposed include: shipping and/or billing name, shipping and/or billing address, shipping and/or billing telephone number, email address, order details, order amount, and payment method. The company stated that information relating to 202 orders was viewed without authorization, but since the website's system does not allow the company to fully identify which order information was viewed, the company considers all customers associated to the 7,673 orders may have been affected.

The company took the online store down when it discovered the breach on October 23, and is currently investigating the incident. Good Smile Company claimed that it has since "strengthened system security," and added that it has removed the vulnerability that it identified as the cause for the security breach. The company has also reported the incident to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission, in accordance with Japanese law.

The company now states that 2,800 customers who may have entered their information on the website's credit card payment page during that time may be affected by the issue, and their information such as cardholder's name, complete 16-digit card number, expiration date, and security code may have been exposed. The company stated that it has contacted the affected customers by email separately.

Additionally, the company stated that customers who have previously registered their credit card information on the website may have their partial information exposed, including the last four digits of the card and expiration date. The company confirmed that cardholders' names or security codes have not been exposed, and no registered member information linked to the exposed partial information was exposed. The company estimated that the number of credit cards that may have partial information exposed is 402,466 excluding duplicates.

The company added that 7,673 customers who placed orders on October 22 between shortly before 10:20 p.m. JST and shortly before 11:00 p.m. JST may have their order information exposed. Information that may have been exposed include: shipping and/or billing name, shipping and/or billing address, shipping and/or billing telephone number, email address, order details, order amount, and payment method. The company stated that information relating to 202 orders was viewed without authorization, but since the website's system does not allow the company to fully identify which order information was viewed, the company considers all customers associated to the 7,673 orders may have been affected.

The company took the online store down when it discovered the breach on October 23, and is currently investigating the incident. Good Smile Company claimed that it has since "strengthened system security," and added that it has removed the vulnerability that it identified as the cause for the security breach. The company has also reported the incident to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission, in accordance with Japanese law.

title: 'Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru' Announces Additional Cast, Staff
content:
The official website of the Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru ( No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy! ) television anime announced additional cast and staff on Thursday. The anime series adapting Nikita Kitagawa 's adventure fantasy light novel will premiere in January 2027.

Cast Auroia Schmiket: Nao Ojika ( Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ) Don: Kengo Tsujii ( Liar Game ) Guillermo: Tatsuhisa Suzuki ( Nanatsu no Taizai ) Scarlet: Anna Yamaki ( Rifle Is Beautiful ) Latch: Shun Horie ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) Maris: Ayasa Itou ( BanG Dream! ) Volx: Hinata Tadokoro ( Ousama Ranking )

Staff Chief Animation Director: Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Precure Dream Stars! Movie character design), Sumakidori ( Miru: Watashi no Mirai character design) Costume Design, Prop Design: Sumakidori 3DCG Director: Yui Horiuchi ( Isekai Munchkin: HP1 no Mama de Saikyou Saisoku Dungeon Kouryaku ) Color Design: Akemi Tejima ( Hataraku Maou-sama! ) Art Director: Norifumi Nakamura ( Ame to Kimi to ) Editing: Takahiro Adachi ( Hikuidori: Ushuu Boro Tobi-gumi ) Sound Production: Sonilude Sound Director: Yuuichi Imaizumi ( Medalist ) Music: Kyouhei Matsuno ( Kakushite! Makina-san!! )

Haruki Kasugamori ( Astro Note ) is directing the anime at Durandal and Tengu Kobou . Hiroshi Hosokawa is handling the series composition. Hiroshi Miyamoto and Sumakidori are designing the characters.

Kitagawa began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in February 2021. Kodansha began publishing the light novel with illustrations by Meto Sasame under the Kodansha Ranobe Books imprint in June 2022. The second and final volume went on sale in May 2024.

A manga adaptation by Yui Hata began serialization on the Magazine Pocket service in June 2022. Kodansha published the 12th volume on July 9.

Kodansha USA began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service on September 17.

title: M&C! Releases School-Live! Manga in Indonesia
content:
Indonesian publisher M&C! released the first volume of Norimitsu Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba 's School-Live! ( Gakkō Gurashi! ) manga in Indonesia on Wednesday. M&C! is releasing the manga under its Akasha mature imprint.

M&C! describes the manga in Indonesian:

Di SMA Megurigaoka, Yuki Takeya dan teman-temannya menjalani hari-hari sebagai anggota Klub Kehidupan Sekolah. Mereka belajar, memasak, berkebun, dan menghabiskan waktu bersama seperti murid pada umumnya. Namun, di balik keseharian yang tampak damai itu, dunia di luar sekolah telah runtuh akibat wabah zombi. Gedung sekolah yang mereka tempati menjadi benteng terakhir, sementara setiap persediaan makanan, obat-obatan, dan perlengkapan bertahan hidup harus digunakan dengan sehemat mungkin.

Meski dikelilingi bahaya dan kehilangan, para anggota Klub Kehidupan Sekolah terus berusaha mempertahankan harapan dan menjalani kehidupan sebaik mungkin. Perjalanan mereka membawa berbagai tantangan baru, mempertemukan mereka dengan sesama penyintas, sekaligus mengungkap kenyataan pahit tentang dunia yang telah berubah.

Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. Kaihō and Chiba launched School-Live! Letters ( Gakkō Gurashi! Otayori ), a sequel to the manga, in Manga Time Kirara Forward in June 2020, and ended it in August 2021.

The manga inspired a 12-episode television anime series that premiered in July 2015, as well as a live-action film adaptation that opened in Japan in January 2019. The film inspired a four-episode live-action mini-series prequel, titled Gakkō XXX ~Mō Hitotsu no Gakkō Gurashi! ( School XXX - Another School-Live! ), that also debuted on Amazon Prime Video in Japan in January 2019.

Kaihō, along with writer Makoto Fukami and artist Etorouji Shiono , launched the Deep Insanity: Nirvana manga in Square Enix 's Big Gangan magazine in January 2020, and ended it in March 2023. The manga is based on Square Enix 's larger Deep Insanity franchise .

Kaihō is also known for writing scripts for anime, and wrote the anime adaptation of his School-Live! manga. He was also the head writer on both Danganronpa 3 anime (as well as their "Hope Arc" special), was co-writer alongside Makoto Fukami on the anime adaptation of Fukami's Magical Girl Spec-Ops Asuka manga, and was also co-writer on the Akudama Drive original anime alongside its director Tomohisa Taguchi . Most recently, Kaihō wrote the Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers anime.
author: ANN
